claims: Clean CodeRabbit runs that post no PR review never count as `reviewed` (`scripts/pr/pr-ready-state-core.mjs:759-770`, plus the comment loop at `:772-784`): the classifier only returns `reviewed` for a PR review whose body has `**Run ID**` and whose commit is the current head, and it never looks at CodeRabbit's top-level comments, so a clean run that only edits the summary results in `stale` or `missing` and the closeout posts a request

A clean run triggered by our own request has the same blind spot: the state then stays `requested` for that head forever, the babysit rule never fires, and the PR is reported as optional lag indefinitely (recurring noise)

The `requested` state trusts any commenter (`pr-ready-state-core.mjs:772-780`): there is no author check, so anyone who can comment can post the marker body and suppress the closeout's own request, leaving the head `requested` and never reviewed
The JSON example in the docs is missing the new gate (`docs/notes/pr-ready-state.md:276-305`): the example `gates` block and top-level fields omit `codeRabbitReviewSignal`

judge_reasoning.3829654081: The review never raises file size or splitting pr-ready-state-core.mjs past the line cap.
judge_reasoning.3829659544: Review finding 3 says the JSON example in docs/notes/pr-ready-state.md omits codeRabbitReviewSignal from the gates block.
judge_reasoning.3829659546: The review does not discuss the ordering of CodeRabbit closeout versus the feedback-state/ready-state pair across the workflow docs and mirrors.
judge_reasoning.3829659550: The review does not flag the null currentHeadOid fallback to timestamps or the acceptance of any request. It assumes the head match is enforced.
judge_reasoning.3830259678: Review finding 2 says the requested state trusts any commenter with no author check, so anyone can post the marker and suppress the request.

1.why: classifyCodeRabbitReviewSignal (core.mjs:759-770) returns `reviewed` only for a CodeRabbit PR review that has `**Run ID**` and the current head commit, and the comment loop (772-784) only matches request markers. The repo's own PR #1918 fixture (feedback-state.test.mjs:3360-3373) shows a clean run reported only as 'No actionable comments were generated' in the walkthrough issue comment, so a clean head ends up `missing` or `stale` and a closeout request gets posted.

2.why: Same blind spot: once a current-head marker comment exists, hasCurrentRequest returns `requested` (core.mjs:786). If the resulting clean run leaves no Run ID review, nothing moves the state to `reviewed`, so the gate stays `requested` with fallbackAction `wait` (core.mjs:1008-1014) for that head.

3.why: Confirmed there is no author check in the comment loop at core.mjs:772-780, but this repeats the known 'core.mjs:772 Trust only authorized closeout requests' item.

4.why: The 'Expected top-level fields' JSON example (pr-ready-state.md:276-305) lists codexReviewSignal in `gates` and at top level but not codeRabbitReviewSignal, even though the code emits both and the field list at :351 documents it. Minor docs gap.
